failedAttempts.meaning: Two legitimate assigned-ticket requests for one merchant both pass empty active check and commit; violates existing one-active-inspection contract. Not an unauthorized-access or provider/hosted incident claim.

fix: Transaction locks merchant row before ticket/request checks, revalidates ticket merchant identity, retains assigned-admin/active-ticket/consent checks; serializes canonical creation across distinct tickets without schema/grant changes.
limits: Owned disposable trigger/advisory gate and two legitimate authenticated HTTP calls; no external services/browser/hosted acceptance
Canonical current creator only; unused older helper and direct external SQL writers not certified
No concurrency/load capacity claim, simultaneous ticket reassignment/deletion/lifecycle signoff, or historical repair
nextExactAction: Read corrected exact-source targeted and broader CI. Require201+409,one request/notice,observed SQL overlap,peer progress and unchanged peer state,rejection releasing next creation,notification-write rollback/retry.
